'''Area D-435''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

==History==
Little was known about this quadrant. It was unremarkable and safe for travel. However, it was best for travelers to keep alert for unexpected enemies in the area. The quadrant was typically inhabited by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and bodyguards of the [[Trader's Guild]]. It was the closest hyperspace quadrant to the [[Endor Space Station]].
